sequential normalizing-flow operations bottlenecking GPUs and TPUs | M3D-stackable PNM with hybrid binary-stochastic floating-point multipliers; 6.6x performance, 3x energy efficiency, 2.2% BPD increase, stochastic-bitstream design guide

blurred low-bitrate reconstructions of distortion-optimized codecs | rate-conditioned flow-matching compensator constrained to the codec quantization cell; Kodak/CLIC2020, LPIPS/FID comparable to MS-ILLM — neural image coding, not ML-system precision reliability
limited semantic selectivity of SAE dictionary atoms | J-space rank-reducing shaping + matched-filter TopK sparse autoencoder; SAEBench and SAE Probes vs dense activations and state-of-the-art SAEs

carbon impact of photonic DPU organizations unquantified | embodied + operational carbon per inference across 6 organizations, 5 transformers, 4 foundry grids vs CPU/H100/TPU v5p — sustainability design study, no listed infra problem

experience-reuse bottleneck assumed to be retrieval fidelity | in-loop memory lifecycle (what to store, when to recall, what to forget) with struggle-gated injection and single-exposure eviction; SWE-ContextBench Lite, 27.6% vs 24.9% resolution in every replicate at -17% cost

one-step drafts inconsistent under shared masked-block token factorization | distilling target-conditioned multi-step refinement into one-step drafting via curriculum; +28% acceptance length, up to 6.45x speedup over autoregressive decoding, 3 model families — verified-exact acceleration, no precision or reliability failure evaluated

attribution-patching estimates far off with costly per-estimate verification | few exact measurements exploiting shared error structure for sign-aware correction; -75 to -79% error on average effects, -26% single-prompt at verify-largest-estimate compute

catastrophic accuracy collapse from learnable 4-bit PTQ calibration | functional-displacement dose analysis + pre-registered validation-gated abstention; 3 embedders, 161 calibration runs, +1.47 to -71.53 NDCG@10, 0 harmful selections in 30 decisions

how many bits suffice to encode data for arbitrary task-family evaluation | greedy dual-VC-dimension encoder with matching worst-case lower bounds; synthetic accuracy-size checks — learning theory, neural-SAE connection exploratory only

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: stored abstractions propagating and regenerating errors (error reproduction) | anti-persistence memory design reconstructing guidance on demand and discarding it after execution; higher held-out success at lowest LLM-call cost across benchmarks and backbones

failed trajectories not revealing how the execution harness should change | knowledge-probing co-evolution with sandboxed paired evaluation of bounded revisions; Minecraft mining/combat/crafting, beats fixed and knowledge-only harness evolution, transfers to unseen tasks

whether sparse dictionaries should reuse the MoE router's choice | expert-aligned autoencoder vs rank-, candidate-, and architecture-matched controls; Gemma 4 26B-A4B block 15, 0.518 vs 0.458/0.387 variance explained, transcoder variant also leads

stochastic errors propagating through actions and context, capping terminal-agent reliability | trajectory + runtime-monitor trace analysis, handbook-guided harness revision with measured-gain gating; success and reliability across models, transfer to unseen benchmarks

decisions.anchor: hardware and node failures and their detection
decisions.reason: adversarial corrupted worker outputs distorting recovered distributed computations | smoothness-regularized robust encoder/decoder avoiding fault localization; worst-case error O((q/N)^{6/5}) vanishing for sublinear adversaries; scalar and NN-inference experiments

controller feature sets missing decision-relevant information | exact optimal-loss decision-sufficiency computation + conflict characterization; SAE-feature audit in Qwen2.5/SmolLM2/Phi, +0.0345-0.1166 minimum average loss with 2 features on SmolLM2

which synthetic questions carry distillation value | distributional surrogate (teacher-student disagreement + teacher mass on student support) without reference answers or correctness rewards; math, code, agentic tasks, beats unoptimized and KL-filtered real questions

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: claimed richness of hidden states for error detection | output-side-combined baseline vs adding hidden states under identical splits; open-ended and multiple-choice tasks, AUROC gains only +0.004/+0.039

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: unattended self-improvement changes silently altering task outcomes | verifier-strength and recoverability measurements with a platform gating rule; tau2-bench experiments — judge insensitive in 9 of 37 settings, regenerated undo fails, deployed change alters 17% of outcomes

when one represented mobility map serves every loss from a single initialization | joint-rank classification, closure equivalences, delayed-bracket counterexample; frozen engineered-loss check — optimization-geometry theory, not LLM hidden-state analysis
